bugs.error_message: Runtime error: Maximum update depth exceeded when re-entering a preserved Rivet TUI session.
bugs.root_cause: useSyncExternalStore getSnapshot returned a fresh object on every render even when terminal rows/columns were unchanged, so React repeatedly detected a changed external-store snapshot and re-rendered.
bugs.fix: Cached the terminal-size snapshot object and return the same reference while rows/columns are unchanged; added a regression test for stable snapshot identity.
